Dear Lesley,

I am writing to confirm how Jeffrey would prefer the scholarship to be named that was
       created through his contribution to Tribeca Ball 2012. This scholarship will be
       given to a continuing Academy student at this spring's commencement ceremony
       on Friday, May 18, 2012.

In order for us to finalize our award process, please confirm before Friday, May 4.

Thank you for helping coordinate all these details.

Best,
Liz
